note: Official Blender v5.2.0 plus our headless wasm changes and our existing export/session integration. Dependencies are rebuilt from pinned official sources. No third-party Blender port commits or build scripts are inputs. PROXY_TO_PTHREAD, WasmFS, 512 MiB initial / 4 GiB maximum memory, twelve-worker pool. Build information is disabled. The source release includes the exact source tree, materialized startup.blend, dependency archives, pure Python wheels, and notices.
callTrampoline: CPython 3.13.13 is compiled with PY_CALL_TRAMPOLINE for Blender CPython slot arity casts. This applies to CPython dispatch, not arbitrary indirect calls.
engineIds: The existing session registers Python render engines under CYCLES, BLENDER_EEVEE and BLENDER_WORKBENCH; the headless build permits built-in IDs to be shadowed.
exportDoor: The source-owned bpy_web_export.cc exports Principled physical inputs, normal images, eight named UV layers and evaluated corner normals, and takes graph_materials/graph_images/graph_generated (a graph-drawn shader mix reduced to the one Principled BSDF it reaches, graph images at the door revisions with every UDIM tile, orco for deformed meshes whose graph reads Generated coordinates). A frame can defer its changed meshes and pictures (defer) for the caller to pull one at a time (export_mesh, export_image), each call freeing the previous one's columns and a picture it decoded; an undo step keeps the revisions when Blender kept the depsgraph (session_undo); Blender's CPU subdivision descriptor is released once a mesh is read; the memory door reports malloc in-use and free. Datablock revisions are keyed by session_uid. writefile.cc writes one copy of the document per save in the browser build.
preloadedPayload: releasePreloadedFileData releases the JS preload buffer after session ready. The measured working payload exclusions are retained.
